title: A remote engine drop shows one toast, not two
description: When the Pod's engine dies mid-generation the user got two near-identical 'may have run out of memory' toasts: one from the remote:engine-dropped listener in shell.js and one from commandExecutor's engine_dropped branch (one more per extra pending generation). The shell listener now owns the remote toast and keeps the 'try a shorter or smaller generation' hint when a generation was running; commandExecutor toasts only for a local engine crash.
